title: Wiesemann & Theis GmbH: Multiple Devices are affected by PHP2Shell
description: Multiple devices from Wiesemann & Theis GmbH running versions 1.31 and 1.51 are affected by a vulnerability known as PHP2Shell. Exploitation of this vulnerability could allow an attacker to gain control over the affected PHP process via the web interface, potentially leading to unauthorized access, data manipulation, or disruption of device functionality.
